newsitem.title: CHILE: Enersis exonerated in antitrust suit -lawyer.
newsitem.headline: Enersis exonerated in antitrust suit -lawyer.

text.p: Chile's Anti-Monopoly Commission rejected a suit against electricity holding company Enersis that charged it with monopolistic practices, said the lawyer who filed the suit.
Lawyer Ramon Briones said the anti-monopoly commission, due to announce the ruling late Wednesday, had informed him that it had decided unanimously in favor of Enersis.
"I was informed that the commission ruled in favor of Enersis' arguments," Briones told Reuters.
The decision was due to be announced at around 1900 local time/EDT.

Briones and state prosecutors, acting on behalf of Chilean power consumers, charged that Enersis' "vertical integration" investment plan violated antitrust codes because it put the company in all three stages of the power business -- generation, transmission and distribution.

The plaintiffs charged that Enersis' involvement in the three areas had a chilling effect on competition in the whole sector, noting that no new power company has joined Chile's central electricity grid in 10 years despite fast economic growth.
A laywer for Enersis later confirmed the news that the commission had ruled 5-0 in favor the company.

Enersis' is the main shareholder of power generator Endesa, of which it owns 25 percent. Endesa in turn owns 100 percent of power transmission company Transelec and a controlling stake in distributor Chilectra.
The company, whose only real competitor is Chilgener, has fought off antitrust challenges in the past.

But the current suit was filed after Enersis raised its share in Endesa to 25 percent from 19 percent in late 1995, making it largest shareholder in Chile's biggest generator. Enersis General Manager Jos Yuraszeck is also the president of Endesa.

The share prices of Enersis, Endesa and Chilectra all rose sharply on the Santiago Stock Exchange, largely on expectations that the ruling would go in their favor. ((-- Paulina Modiano, Santiago newsroom +56-2-699-5595 x211))
